flags.issue: Call observation dates are 'each coupon observation date ... commencing March 2027' with no interim-only carve-out, so the final determination date is taken as callable (11 levels). Economically equivalent to maturity payoff at >=100%, but a human should confirm 11 vs 10 entries.
Coupon given only as cumulative cash formula ($0.25 x n minus previously paid) per $10; converted to 2.50% per quarter. No per-annum rate printed.
Russell 2000 printed to 3 decimals (2,837.552); others to 2.
Tickers taken from Bloomberg symbols ('SPX Index', 'RTY Index', 'SX5E Index') with ' Index' suffix dropped.
Ninth payment date 2029-01-02 (crosses year-end holiday); copied as printed, not derived.

scope.reason: Worst-of three equity indices (SPX, RTY, SX5E), quarterly memory contingent coupon, discrete autocall at 100% from obs 2, European (determination-date-only) 80% downside threshold with 1:1 loss; no buffer, no daily monitoring.
